cards.title: Prepare to leave {from.area} {from.block}
instructions: Exit by climbing or descending to a transition layer within the area, through an unoccupied area (coordinate on CH 22), or laterally
Avoid North Mustang (6,500–17,500 ft MSL) at all times
Minimum altitude over the Aransas Wildlife Refuge is 3,000 ft AGL
cards.detail: Proceeding north instead? Contact Houston Center on CH 23 (VHF 128.15) and request flight following. Houston Center will not provide it without an explicit request.
cards.source: Binder, p. 14; Feb 2026 PPT, Part 1, slide 96.

cards.title: Announce your departure on Foxtrot Common
Report complete Foxtrot

exchange.speaker: Approach
exchange.text: <callsign>, Corpus Approach, roger, proceed as requested.

cards.detail: The binder gives "complete Foxtrot, request (transition)" and a "Roger, proceed as requested" reply. Check with an instructor for the exact wording.
